name: Closeout → continuity loop (session ritual)
summary: an end-of-session skill: sweep loose ends, spot-check live state, write the continuity block (what landed with commit hashes, corrections, loose ends, TOMORROW FIRST), touch the state snapshot, update the tracker, stamp every record with author/model/time from the live clock, commit scoped — so the NEXT session reconstructs today from the repository alone
requires: a repo with a continuity folder, a state snapshot and (optionally) a tracker file
the record-lint pattern to enforce the stamps
retires: the 'where did we leave off' reconstruction at the start of every session, and the trust-wait on an unstamped handoff
